evidence.claim: Card C09177-K1 experienced an abrupt activity shift: all 51 baseline transactions between 2016-10-29 and the alert were in-person purchases for product W, whereas transactions 3660354 ($261.61) and 3660355 ($228.01) on 2017-01-26 and 2017-01-27 were online purchases for product C.
The flagged transaction 3660355 and preceding transaction 3660354 were conducted from device D009729, which is marked New for this account with no prior history on the card.
The two online product-C transactions within 20 hours totaling $489.62 match an active attack signature seen across three peer cards (C03040-K2, C02342-K1, C03528-K1) in January 2017.

case.summary: Card C09177-K1 was alerted after transaction 3660355 ($228.01, online) triggered a real-time risk score of 0.8 on 2017-01-27. Investigation noted two online product C purchases totaling $489.62 from a new device D009729, which differed from the cardholder's established pattern of in-person product W purchases. Mitigating factors included transactions originating within the cardholder's primary billing region 337, absence of proxy usage or fraud ring connections, and an uncompromised account history. Following customer validation in which the cardholder confirmed authorizing the activity, the case was resolved and closed as no fraud.
